world_org_meetings.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Israel on Netanyahu's speech at UNGA
world_org_meetings.description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former U.S. Ambassador to Israel Thomas Nides about Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's speech at the United Nations General Assembly.

world_org_meetings.title: Actors Susan Sarandon, Hannah Einbinder among detained protesters outside Netanyahu's UN speech
world_org_meetings.description: Actors Susan Sarandon and Hannah Einbinder were among the protestors detained in New York City on Thursday as Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivered a speech to the United Nations General Assembly.

world_org_meetings.title: Zelenskyy addresses UN as Rubio of U.S. says Ukraine, Russia have interest in limited ceasefire
world_org_meetings.description: Russia pounded Kyiv with drone strikes on Wednesday, hitting railway infrastructure, warehouses and fuel stations, just hours before Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy addressed the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

world_org_meetings.title: Tensions between India and Bangladesh are in focus after Dhaka skipped the BRICS summit in Delhi
world_org_meetings.description: Bangladesh's absence from the BRICS summit in New Delhi has raised fresh questions about strained ties. Ousted PM Sheikh Hasina's exile in India remains a major obstacle to normalizing relations.

world_org_meetings.title: Syrian leader lashes out at Israel in UN speech, says Golan is inseparable part of Syria
world_org_meetings.description: Syria's leader has lashed out at Israel in a speech to the United Nations General Assembly

diplomatic_visits.title: Former U.S. ambassador to China on Xi Jinping's visit to Washington
diplomatic_visits.description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former U.S. Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns about Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington and what has been accomplished.

diplomatic_visits.title: Fanfare surrounds Trump-Xi summit at White House, but no breakthroughs expected
diplomatic_visits.description: U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday for a lavish state summit that was heavy on symbolism but light on substance, with no sign that a closed-door meeting yielded breakthroughs on thorny issues such as AI, trade, Taiwan and the war with Iran.

diplomatic_visits.title: Vietnam's president upgrades Canada to strategic partner during state visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Vietnamese President Tô Lâm has upgraded ties with Canada to a strategic partnership, building on Prime Minister Mark Carney's efforts to get middle powers working more closely together to confront American and Chinese coercion.

diplomatic_visits.title: Trump greets Xi on tarmac as Chinese leader arrives for state visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington on Wednesday, where he was met with a rare planeside greeting from U.S. President Donald Trump after their top officials agreed to extend a trade truce until January.

diplomatic_visits.title: In China, the Xi-Trump summit is seen as projecting image of the country’s rise
diplomatic_visits.description: U.S. President Donald Trump’s elaborate reception of Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington, D.C., has impressed the Chinese public

elections.title: Morocco votes for new parliament amid hopes and concerns over cost of living
elections.description: Hopes and concerns over jobs, wages, public services and cost of living dominate Morocco’s parliamentary election as the country prepares for the 2030 World Cup.

elections.title: Switzerland’s neutrality vote is asking the wrong question
elections.description: The real question is what neutrality can still do for Switzerland.

elections.title: Russia's parliamentary election result underscores public support for Kremlin policies, Putin says
elections.description: President Vladimir Putin says Russia’s first wartime parliamentary election, which further strengthened the Kremlin’s already-overwhelming legislative control, was a sign of public support for his policies

elections.title: International watchdog calls for protection of journalists ahead of Serbia election
elections.description: An international media watchdog says that journalists in Serbia are increasingly under threat of violence and hostility ahead of a high-stakes early parliamentary election that will test populist President Aleksandar Vucic’s rule

elections.title: Brazil’s Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro still essentially tied in new poll
elections.description: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is up two points, but that's still within the poll's margin of error.
